Milotic

Water

Hoenn · Generation 3

Milotic is a Water-type Tender Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 6.2 m tall and weighs 162 kg. It evolves from Feebas. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (125), with a base stat total of 540.
